name: Coastguard Support Unit
notes: The official coastal_support field is displayed as required Support Units on Coastguard and Coastal Rescue missions. It is distinct from the CRV/coastal_rescue requirement.
Cost, staffing, capacity and station compatibility remain unpublished in the retained official mission evidence.
Official UK guidance publishes the Coastguard Support Unit crew range, cost, station compatibility and Flood Rescue Unit towing role.
